en.name: Knight's Title (Rush Duel)
en.effect: Send 1 Spellcaster Type monster from your hand or 1 face-up Spellcaster Type monster from your field to the Graveyard. Then, if you have "Dark Magician" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician Knight" from your hand or Graveyard face-up to your field.
